title: Cluniac, Humiliati, Minim, Discalced Carmelite and Santiago Mass-book witnesses

traditions.label: Cluniac use
traditions.scope: Four individually identified printed Cluniac missals, kept apart from the undated history of their texts and reception.
traditions.coverage_note: The 1493 and 1733 catalogue duplicates are not extra editions. The 1717 title claims General Chapter authority, but the underlying act and the 1717–1733 component changes are unverified.

traditions.label: Humiliati use
traditions.scope: One fifteenth-century manuscript and one 1504 printed whole missal identified in USUARIUM.
traditions.coverage_note: The manuscript's copying range and the printed book's publication date do not establish a revision or direct descent.

traditions.label: Order of Minims
traditions.scope: A catalogued eighteenth-century Mass proper and the Holy See's 1976 approval of Latin and Italian Mass and Office propers.
traditions.coverage_note: The 1569 Manuale has unverified Mass content and is not represented as a missal; the 1976 notice is an approval, not a dated publication or observed use.

traditions.label: Discalced Carmelites (OCD)
traditions.scope: Individually dated Latin Mass proper books and the order's 2025 second typical edition with its complementary lectionary.
traditions.coverage_note: 1925, 1950 and 1959 are proper witnesses, not whole missals. Their Mass texts are uncollated; the 2025 printed Latin decree controls its dates and scoped local calendar grades.

traditions.label: Military Order of Santiago
traditions.scope: The identified 1560 order missal only; earlier print reports, an unverified manuscript and an evangeliary are kept as gaps or contextual components.
traditions.coverage_note: The 1536 authorization request and 1541 inventory do not date the first printing. The 1560 catalogue date does not itself establish a distinct rite or a third-edition text history.

sources.title: USUARIUM 272, BnF B-308 Cluniac missal
sources.inspection: Opened exact book page: 1493 age, BnF B-308 shelfmark, order-use title and indexed temporal, ordinary, canon, sanctoral and other Mass sections.
sources.limitations: Original title and colophon uninspected; the printer lifespan in the catalogue deserves independent date review. USUARIUM book 3349 may be another copy or duplicate entry.

sources.title: BnF cb36821193b, Paris Simon Vostre Cluniac missal
sources.inspection: Opened owning BnF record: Paris Simon Vostre 1510, reserve Arsenal 8-T-2452 among listed copies; USUARIUM 5837 independently indexes the Mass sections of that shelfmark.
sources.limitations: Original book leaves not checked and no 1493–1510 textual difference established.

sources.title: BnF cb36821196c, Paris Louis Sevestre Cluniac missal
sources.inspection: Opened owning BnF record: 1717 imprint, order-use title claiming General Chapter authority, B-309 and Arsenal FOL-T-758 copies.
sources.limitations: The cited General Chapter decision, original title and Mass contents have not been read; title language is not promoted into a dated approval event.

sources.title: BnF cb36821197q, Paris Pierre Simon Cluniac missal
sources.inspection: Opened owning BnF record: 1733 imprint, order-use title, Arsenal FOL-T-759 and other copies; USUARIUM 5693 agrees on title, year and shelfmark.
sources.limitations: Original contents uncollated; USUARIUM 5693 and 7091 must be copy-deduplicated.

sources.title: USUARIUM 746, Venegono FV. B. VII. 45 Humiliati missal
sources.inspection: Opened exact manuscript description: 1400–1500 copying range, Venegono shelfmark, librarian's Humiliati attribution and indexed ordinary, canon, temporal, sanctoral, common and votive Mass sections.
sources.limitations: Librarian's use attribution and catalogue date need manuscript-level review; no folio collation or localized use evidence.

sources.title: USUARIUM 8571, Braidense AB. XIV. 10 Humiliati missal
sources.inspection: Opened exact book description: Milan Antonius Zarotus 1504, Braidense AB. XIV. 10, Humiliati title, temporal, ordinary, canon, sanctoral, votive and colophon indices.
sources.limitations: The original colophon and contents are not independently read; the more precise 25 January date in inventory still requires original-page confirmation.

sources.title: Google Books catalogue, Missae propriae SS. Ordinis Minimorum (1756)
sources.inspection: The existing dated Western inventory review identified the 1756 proper title and 48-page bibliographic record; the viewer was reopened, but no original page text was available in this pass.
sources.limitations: Metadata-only witness. Publisher, original text, approval and relation to later proper remain unchecked.

sources.title: Missae propriae SS. Ordini Minimorum Sancti Francisci de Paula, Lyon: Amatus Delaroche, 1756 (Google Books page images)
sources.inspection: Prior-lane page images PR1–PR4 (title, index of Masses, pp. iii–iv) rehashed and viewed on 21 October 2026.
sources.limitations: Four pages; the Mass texts beyond the opening Introit and the mensural Mass settings were not read. The digitized copy carries an Antwerp library stamp.

sources.title: Notitiae 12 (1976), Minim Latin and Italian proper confirmation
sources.inspection: Downloaded and inspected official journal printed p. 308: 14 June 1976, CD 405/76 confirms Latin text and Italian translation of the Minim Mass and Office proper. Printed p. 310 separately confirms the order calendar under the same protocol.
sources.limitations: Approval summary only; no edition, complete text, first use or regionally bounded Italian implementation is established.

sources.title: OCD Proprium Missarum, Mechlin 1925 facsimile
sources.inspection: Existing dated Western inventory review checked PDF pp. 1–2: order-use proper title and separate 1920 order approval, 1921 concordance and 1924 imprimatur before 1925 printing. This pass downloaded the image-only scan without making new textual claims.
sources.limitations: Rights to redistribute host facsimile not established; original proper text and its relation to 1950 are uncollated.

sources.title: OCD Proprium Missarum et Officiorum, Desclée 1950 facsimile
sources.inspection: Existing dated Western inventory review checked original PDF pp. 2–3 and identified the Discalced Carmelite, not calced Carmelite, title and 1950 imprint.
sources.limitations: Mass text, approval instrument and relation to the 1925 printing are uncollated.

sources.title: OCD Proprium Missarum et Officiorum, 1959 facsimile
sources.inspection: Existing dated Western inventory review checked PDF pp. 1–3: order title, 28 August 1958 approval in front matter and 1959 printing.
sources.limitations: The 1958 order approval does not alone establish a Mass-specific change from 1950; complete texts are uncollated.

sources.title: Sacred Congregation for Divine Worship, OCD calendar and Latin proper confirmations, Notitiae 8 (1972)
sources.inspection: Notitiae 8 (1972) printed p. 358 (issue 78, PDF p. 20) and p. 362 (PDF p. 24) rendered and viewed; printed p. 12 (issue 69, PDF p. 18, prior-lane copy rehashed) rendered and viewed.
sources.limitations: Summaries of decrees, not the decrees or the printed 1973 book.

sources.title: OCD Proprium Missarum editio typica altera, Latin Missale 2025
sources.inspection: Downloaded and read printed pp. 1–4: 2025 title, 16 July Dicastery recognition Prot. 726/23, 15 August order promulgation Prot. 2025/326 DF, 30 November obligation, and specified calendar grades in houses of India, Italy and France.
sources.limitations: The order's English web notice says 20 November although its Latin decree says 30 November; this dossier follows the printed decree. The whole text is not transcribed or compared to the earlier typical edition; local-language translations require separate approval.

sources.title: USUARIUM 8572, Missale Ordinis Militiae Sancti Iacobi de Spata
sources.inspection: Opened exact catalogue entry: Santiago military-order origin, missal genre, 1560 age. The existing IEC specialist study identifies León printer Pedro de Celada and a Colombina exemplar but no original page is inspected here.
sources.limitations: Catalogue date and scholarly bibliography only; original title, correction instrument, Mass contents and claimed earlier editions remain unchecked.

stages.label: BnF B-308 Cluniac missal
stages.scope: Whole order-use missal identified by exact catalogue copy, not a proved textual reform.
stages.summary: The catalogue records a Cluniac missal with Mass ordinary, canon and propers at the 1493 horizon.

evidence.locus: USUARIUM 272, title, age, shelfmark and contents index
evidence.claim: Identifies the 1493 B-308 Cluniac missal and its Mass sections.

stages.limitations: Original colophon/date and USUARIUM's same-year duplicate need review; neither order-wide adoption nor subsequent descent is demonstrated.
stages.reception: Order-use title only, without a house-level use record.

stages.label: Simon Vostre Cluniac missal
stages.summary: BnF records a 1510 Paris printing by Simon Vostre, distinct as an imprint from the 1493 and later catalogued books.

evidence.locus: BnF cb36821193b, title, publication and Arsenal reserve copy
evidence.claim: The 1510 printing and identified surviving copy are catalogued.

stages.limitations: No component comparison proves whether the 1510 book revises or reproduces the 1493 book.
stages.reception: Publication for the order is identified; use by any named house is unverified.

stages.label: Louis Sevestre Cluniac missal
stages.scope: Exact whole-missal printing; title's General Chapter authority remains an unverified act claim.
stages.summary: BnF records the 1717 Cluniac missal and transcribes its claim of General Chapter authorization.

evidence.locus: BnF cb36821196c, title, imprint and B-309 holding
evidence.claim: An identified 1717 Cluniac missal survives; its title names General Chapter authority.

stages.limitations: The chapter act and book body were not inspected; no new approval event or change from 1510 is asserted.
stages.reception: Authority claimed on catalogue title, without checked chapter decree or local adoption.

stages.label: Pierre Simon Cluniac missal
stages.witness_label: BnF Arsenal FOL-T-759, Paris Pierre Simon
stages.summary: BnF records a 1733 order-use missal and an identified Arsenal copy.

evidence.locus: BnF cb36821197q, title, imprint and FOL-T-759 holding
evidence.claim: The 1733 Paris Pierre Simon order missal is a distinct catalogued printing.

stages.limitations: The 1717–1733 Mass texts and duplicate USUARIUM records are uncollated; no reform or final-use date is inferred.
stages.reception: Order-use title, with no checked adoption by a named monastery.

stages.label: Venegono Humiliati-use missal manuscript
stages.scope: Manuscript with Mass ordinary, canon and propers, under a qualified use attribution.
stages.summary: The catalogue gives a fifteenth-century copying range and a librarian's Humiliati attribution for a whole missal.

evidence.locus: USUARIUM 746, shelfmark, age, remark and contents pp. 20–43
evidence.claim: The codex has indexed temporal, ordinary, canon, sanctoral, common and votive Mass sections.

stages.limitations: The range dates copying only; the manuscript and use attribution are not independently inspected.
stages.reception: A later librarian attributed the codex to the Humiliati; no house-use episode is dated.

stages.label: 1504 Milan Humiliati missal
stages.scope: Whole order-use printed missal, identified by exact Braidense copy.
stages.summary: The catalogue identifies a 1504 Milan Zarotus print whose title and indexed sections name the Humiliati order and the Mass.

evidence.locus: USUARIUM 8571, title, age, printer, shelfmark and contents pp. 18–69
evidence.claim: A dated printed Humiliati missal and its Mass sections are identified.

stages.limitations: Original colophon and claimed 25 January day remain unchecked; relation to Venegono manuscript is unknown.
stages.reception: Order-use title, with no demonstrated house distribution.

stages.label: 1756 Minim saints' Mass proper
stages.scope: Mass proper for Minim saints, not a complete missal.
stages.summary: The title presents notated Masses proper to the Minims, conceded by various popes, printed at Lyon by Amatus Delaroche in 1756. The index lists Masses of Francis of Paula, Gabriel, the Seven Sorrows, the Patronage of St Joseph, Raphael, a Mass conceded to certain kingdoms and All Souls, followed by named mensural Mass settings.

evidence.locus: Google Books id mCzcRyDjD6kC, bibliographic title, date and 48-page extent
evidence.claim: The 1756 object is a Mass proper, rather than an order whole missal.

evidence.locus: Title page (PR1); Index Missarum (PR2); pp. iii–iv (PR3–PR4)
evidence.claim: Title, imprint 'Lugduni, typis Amati Delaroche ... M.DCC.LVI', index of Masses and the notated Introit Caritas Dei for Francis of Paula, 2 April, duplex I classis with octave.

stages.limitations: Title and index read on page images; the Mass texts are not transcribed. The 1569 Manuale has no established Mass contents.
stages.reception: Intended order use in title; actual use not documented.

stages.label: 1976 Minim Latin and Italian Mass proper approval
stages.scope: Holy See confirmation of Latin text and Italian translation of the Mass and Hours proper, plus separately noted order calendar.
stages.summary: The official journal confirms the Latin and Italian Minim propers and records a particular order calendar under one protocol.

evidence.claim: 14 June 1976 confirmation names Latin and Italian texts of the Minim Mass and Office proper and an order calendar.

stages.limitations: An approval summary is not the printed proper or proof of a revised whole missal; first Italian use and any territorial limit remain unknown.
stages.reception: Approval for order texts, without evidence of a particular house's implementation.

stages.label: 1925 OCD Mass proper
stages.date_label: 1925 printing; earlier front-matter acts separately dated
stages.scope: Discalced Carmelite Mass proper, not a full missal.
stages.summary: The facsimile front matter separates 1920 order approval, 1921 concordance, 1924 imprimatur and 1925 printing.

evidence.locus: Facsimile PDF pp. 1–2, title and front-matter dated instruments
evidence.claim: The 1925 publication year is distinct from earlier approval and imprimatur dates.

stages.limitations: Original Mass text not collated against other OCD propers; no reform transition follows from the printing year.
stages.reception: Order-use proper with named front matter; particular-house use unverified.

stages.label: 1950 OCD Mass and Office proper
stages.scope: Order Mass and Office proper; its Mass component is the relevant stage.
stages.witness_label: Proprium Missarum et Officiorum OCD, Desclée 1950
stages.summary: The inspected title identifies Discalced Carmelite ownership and a 1950 edition.

evidence.locus: Facsimile PDF pp. 2–3, original title and imprint
evidence.claim: The book is a 1950 OCD proper, not an OCarm edition.

stages.limitations: No verified Mass-text difference from 1925 or 1959; front-matter act relation unresolved.
stages.reception: Order proper title only; no local use event is checked.

stages.label: 1959 OCD Mass and Office proper
stages.scope: Order Mass and Office proper, with an earlier approval distinguished from its print date.
stages.summary: The facsimile title identifies a 1959 OCD proper and its front matter reports a 1958 order approval.

evidence.locus: Facsimile PDF pp. 1–3, title and order approval
evidence.claim: The proper printing and order approval carry different dates.

stages.limitations: The order approval and printing alone cannot prove which Mass prayers changed from the 1950 volume.
stages.reception: Order-issued proper; use at named houses not verified.

stages.label: 1971–1972 OCD postconciliar calendar and Latin proper confirmations
stages.date_label: Calendar confirmed 20 October 1971 (Prot. 1653/71); Latin Mass and Hours texts confirmed 17 and 22 September 1972 (Prot. 666/72, 1131/72)
stages.scope: Confirmed postconciliar Latin proper of Masses and Hours according to the order's proper calendar; the 1973 printed typical edition itself is not inspected.
stages.witness_label: Acts only: Notitiae 8 (1972) pp. 12, 358, 362; the reported 1973 typical edition (western:mendicant-ocd-1973) is not linked because its title, date and contents are uninspected
stages.summary: The Congregation confirmed the order's proper calendar on 20 October 1971, confirmed variations in it on 20 July 1972, confirmed the Latin texts of Masses and Hours according to that calendar on 17 and 22 September 1972, and on 4 October 1972 allowed the Transverberation of St Teresa to be added.

evidence.claim: Ordo Fratrum Discalceatorum B.M.V. de Monte Carmelo, 20 Oct. 1971 (Prot. n. 1653/71): proper calendar confirmed.
17 and 22 Sept. 1972 (Prot. nn. 666/72 and 1131/72): Latin texts of Masses and Liturgy of the Hours according to the order's proper calendar confirmed.
20 July 1972 (Prot. n. 969/72) calendar variations confirmed; 4 Oct. 1972 (Prot. n. 1285/72) the calendar completed with S. Teresia ab Avila, In transverberatione cordis.

stages.limitations: The acts precede the reported 1973 printing; that book's title, date and contents remain uninspected, so it is not linked as a witness. The calendar component rests on the 1971 confirmation as varied in 1972; the stage year is that of the Latin text confirmation. No text transition from the 1959 proper is asserted.
stages.reception: Confirmation for the order; dated house use is not documented.

stages.label: 2025 OCD Latin proper, second typical edition
stages.date_label: 16 July 2025 recognition; 15 August promulgation; 30 November obligatory use
stages.scope: Order Latin Mass proper with companion lectionary, rather than a replacement for the Roman whole missal.
stages.witness_label: Proprium Missarum OCD, Missale and Lectionarium, editio typica altera
stages.summary: A 2025 dicastery recognition and the order's promulgation establish the second Latin typical proper; the calendar names specific house-region grades.

evidence.locus: Printed pp. 1–4: title, Prot. 726/23, Prot. 2025/326 DF, and calendar
evidence.claim: The Latin edition is recognized 16 July, promulgated 15 August, obligatory from 30 November 2025, with named local memorial grades for India, Italy and France.

stages.limitations: The first typical edition and complete text have not been collated; the order's English article's 20 November date conflicts with the printed Latin decree's 30 November. Local translations require their own approval.
stages.reception: The order decree establishes prescribed use once published and from the stated obligation date; actual house-level celebration remains unverified.

stages.label: 1560 Santiago military-order missal
stages.scope: Catalogued whole order missal, without claimed textual genealogy to reported earlier editions.
stages.witness_label: Missale Ordinis Militiae Sancti Iacobi de Spata, USUARIUM 8572
stages.summary: The catalogue identifies a 1560 Santiago military-order missal; a specialist report supplies a León printer and Colombina copy lead.

evidence.locus: USUARIUM 8572, title, order origin, genre and age
evidence.claim: A 1560 Santiago order missal is catalogued.

stages.limitations: The original 1560 copy and Martín Pérez de Ayala correction instrument are uninspected; scholarly claims that it was a third edition are not a demonstrated transmission chain.
stages.reception: The order title implies intended use; particular-house reception is not evidenced.
